introduction: DC’s 211 Warmline helps residents find social-service resources. It is a referral line for non-emergency needs.
description: DC’s 211 Warmline helps residents find social-service resources. It is a referral line for non-emergency needs.

sections.who: District residents can use the Warmline. Individual referred programs assess their own eligibility.
sections.get: An agent helps identify local services. Live hours are Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; after-hours voicemail calls are returned within one to two business days.
sections.docs:

  • A callback number if leaving voicemail.
sections.apply:
1. Call the Warmline

    Dial 211 in the District, or 202-463-6211 while outside DC.

  2. Describe the need

    Explain whether you need food, family support or another community service.

  3. Follow up with the referral

    Ask the provider about current intake and evidence requirements.
sections.after: Keep referral names and numbers. For an emergency call 911; for mental-health distress or thoughts of self-harm, call 988.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using 211 Warmline hours and contact. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
